related_questions.question: Do I need to report a positive home COVID test?
related_questions.snippet: Q. Do I need to report my at-home COVID-19 test results? A. The FDA encourages you to voluntarily and anonymously report your positive or negative test results every time you use an at-home COVID-19 test.

related_questions.question: What should I do if I have a positive COVID-19 test?
related_questions.snippet: If your COVID-19 test is positive Monitor your symptoms. If you have any emergency warning signs, seek emergency care immediately. Seek health care right away for treatment if you have risk factors for severe illness. Treatment may be an option to make your symptoms less severe and shorten the time you are sick.

related_questions.question: How long should you be off work after a positive COVID test?
related_questions.snippet: In accordance with guidance from the CDC, if you test positive for COVID-19 you should: Isolate for 5 days regardless of vaccination status. Only leave isolation after 5 days if you have no symptoms or your symptoms are improving, including at least 24 hours without a fever.
